description:
Scans the companies in a watchlist, or cancels a scan in progress.

Called without max_credits, this only reports what a scan would cover and cost, and
starts nothing. Do that first and confirm the cost with the user. Then call it again
with max_credits to start. If the cost has risen above that figure, nothing starts.

Companies read in the last 20 hours are skipped without charge, so re-running after
a partial failure only pays for what is missing. Pass older_than_days to also leave
out companies this list scanned more recently than that.

Scans run in the background, and a long list can take hours. Follow progress with
get_watchlist, which also shows how many signals each company has; read the ones
worth a closer look with get_company_signals. A cancel stops what has not started
and returns those credits.

Cost: 62 credits per company scanned with the default modules, changing with the modules you choose. Estimates and cancelling are free, and credits come back for any company that could not be read.

cancel.description: Cancel instead of starting. Cancels every scan in progress on this list, or only run_id if given.

deliver_webhook.description: Also notify this key's webhook URL when the scan finishes. Default false.

dry_run.description: Only report the cost, even if max_credits is set. Default false.

max_credits.description: The most this scan may spend. Required to start one. Without it the call is an estimate.

modules.description: What to read, from: signals, funding, news, social (X posts), hiring (open roles and headcount), business. Defaults to signals, funding, news and social.

older_than_days.description: Only scan companies this list has not scanned in this many days.

run_id.description: With cancel, the scan to cancel.

watchlist.description: The list, by its id (wl_...) or its exact name.
